title: Occupation Times at a Moving Interface and Sharp Yosida Rates for MacKean-Vlasov BSDE with Jumps and Fuzzy Selections
summary: We study a forward-backward McKean-Vlasov system with jumps whose backward equation contains a source obtained by evaluating the minimal-norm selection of a maximal monotone operator along the forward state. This selection changes branch across an interface that moves with the state law, the control, and an imprecisely known parameter described by fuzzy cuts.
